evidence: Scenario reconciliation for an Earth comparison: the land keeps the older climate's screen, and the waters take nutrient-poor rates with an illustrative carbon-use efficiency. The 301 K design run's temperature and water fields come next.

assumptions.aquatic_gpp: Wetzel's oligotrophic bracket as recorded secondarily in research/studies/lake_oxygen/sources.json, with the oxygen study's central 0.2 g C/m2/day. Rates are prescribed means over the whole lunar cycle: the oxygen model calibrates its production to this mean. Applied to the open seas and to every lake.
assumptions.aquatic_npp_over_gpp: An illustrative 0.4-0.6 fraction converting the bracket to new biomass. The oxygen study's community respiration includes consumers and decomposers, so it cannot supply this fraction. The source record calls the bracket primary production; if it is a near-net 14C rate, this factor discounts it twice, by about 0.5 Gt C a year in the middle case.
assumptions.coasts: The light-limitation screen's design guesses, with coast and open-sea areas summing to the seas. Their productive communities and nutrient supply are still to be designed.
assumptions.lake_margins: All lake area takes the oligotrophic rate; a productive aquatic lake margin has no separate area yet. Terrestrial wet margins stay in the land component.
assumptions.sky: Sky host production is reported separately until the surface production it displaces is counted; the aerial-productivity study counts it.
assumptions.dry_mass: For an illustrative conversion, dry biomass is 45% carbon by mass on both worlds.
assumptions.screening_estimate: 15-25 Gt C/year around 20 is a rounded screening estimate bracketing the computed surface cases, for discussion while the 301 K design run is pending.

sunlight.status: A light-only sensitivity: surface PAR scaled with total incident sunlight, with clouds, temperature, rain and spectral shape held fixed. The 301 K design run sets the final sunlight scale.

climate_context.claim: The design years are A28R_301k_s0897's years 5-14 at sunlight 0.897; with each run's own leftover imbalance taken from its drift they read 301.2-301.3 K.
The design run rebalances the sunlight, about 3.5-4.5% above 0.897 at the plan's 0.73-0.96% of the sunlight a kelvin.
A short run on the final configuration finds the design run's sunlight (six years at 0.929, 3.6% above 0.897); the branches are reconciled with main once the design run is complete and analysed.
